rules.title: Do not assert a value to any
rules.message: Do not cast to `any` — it switches type checking off. Assert to `unknown` and narrow instead.

examples.bad: declare const input: string; export const v = input as any;
examples.good: declare const input: string; export const v = input as unknown;

input: declare const input: string; export const v = input as any;

rules.title: Use the primitive type string, not the boxed String type
rules.message: Use the primitive type string, not the boxed String object type.

rules.title: Do not assign to element.innerHTML
rules.message: Assigning innerHTML is an XSS vector — use textContent for plain text.

examples.bad: export function put(el: HTMLElement, text: string): void { el.innerHTML = text; }
examples.good: export function put(el: HTMLElement, text: string): void { el.textContent = text; }

input: export function put(el: HTMLElement, text: string): void { el.innerHTML = text; }

rules.title: Do not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML bypasses React's escaping (XSS risk) — render the content as JSX children.

examples.bad: export function D({ markup }: { markup: { __html: string } }) { return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={markup} />; }
examples.good: export function D({ markup }: { markup: { __html: string } }) { return <div title={markup.__html} />; }

input: export function D({ markup }: { markup: { __html: string } }) { return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={markup} />; }

rules.title: Do not use the array index as a list key
rules.message: Use a stable id from the data as key, not the array index.

examples.bad: export function L({ index }: { index: number }) { return <li key={index} />; }
examples.good: export function L({ id }: { id: string }) { return <li key={id} />; }

input: export function L({ index }: { index: number }) { return <li key={index} />; }

rules.title: Every has an alt attribute
rules.message: Give every an alt attribute (alt="" for a decorative image).

examples.bad: export function I({ logo }: { logo: string }) { return ; }
examples.good: export function I({ logo }: { logo: string }) { return ; }

input: export function I({ logo }: { logo: string }) { return ; }
